obligor_aliases: California Health Facilities Financing Authority (CHFFA) — CHLA series

moodys.citation_text: Bond Buyer chronology: 'Moody's dropped the rating to Baa3 from Baa2' in May 2025 — implying the pre-action rating was Baa2. The May 2025 downgrade cited 'three consecutive years of weak financial performance,' consistent with Baa2 being in effect during 2022-2024. PARTIALLY VERIFIED — exact outlook on 2022-12-31 inferred, not from a dated 2022 Moody's press release.

sp.citation_text: Becker's coverage of the Nov 4, 2024 S&P action describes 'lowered the rating to BBB-minus from BBB,' so on 2022-12-31 S&P was at BBB. Outlook (stable) inferred from absence of negative-watch reporting before late 2024.

fitch.citation_text: Trade press on CHLA rating actions consistently references only Moody's and S&P. No Fitch rating identified for CHLA during the window.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Lowered long-term rating to BBB- from BBB and placed on CreditWatch Negative
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Weakened state revenues, Medicaid exposure, Change Healthcare payment cycle disruption.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P 'placed the rating on CreditWatch with negative implications on November 4, 2024, when it lowered the rating to BBB-minus from BBB.'

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed Baa2; outlook revised to Negative from Stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Weakened state revenues and Change Healthcare payment-cycle disruption; high Medicaid exposure
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Per Bond Buyer/Becker's chronology: 'CHLA carried a negative outlook from Moody's since December 2024 because of weakened state revenues and the impact of the Change Healthcare healthcare payment cycle disruptions.'

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Lowered long-term rating to BB+ from BBB-; assigned negative outlook (removed from CreditWatch Negative)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Three consecutive years of weak operating performance; failure to rebuild liquidity; high Medicaid reliance
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: 'In February [2025], S&P Global Ratings lowered its long-term rating on California Health Facilities Financing Authority debt issued for CHLA to BB-plus from BBB-minus with a negative outlook, and removed the rating from CreditWatch where it had been placed with negative implications on November 4, 2024.' This action moved CHLA from investment-grade to speculative-grade with S&P.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's first downgrade (Baa2 to Baa3) was in May 2025, AFTER the 2025-03-31 window end. As of 2025-03-31 Moody's was Baa2/Negative (since Dec 2024 outlook revision).

sp.citation_text: Feb 2025 S&P action lowered to BB+ with negative outlook, in effect at window end.

fitch.citation_text: No Fitch rating on CHLA identified during window.

outcome_class_rationale: S&P downgraded CHLA twice (BBB to BBB- on 2024-11-04; BBB- to BB+ in Feb 2025) for a cumulative 2-notch S&P downgrade that crossed the investment-grade/speculative-grade boundary. Moody's added a Negative outlook revision (Dec 2024). The drop into BB-territory at S&P qualifies as MULTI_DOWNGRADE.

new_actions.rationale: Three consecutive years of weak financial performance; challenged to rebuild liquidity; high state-funding dependence due to significant Medicaid exposure. Negative outlook. Leadership engaged consultant to attain $100M operational improvements over next two FYs.
S&P withdrew rating following February 2025 downgrade to BB+ from BBB-. Withdrawal mechanics not detailed in public coverage.

Material decline in liquidity and operating performance in excess of expectations from most recent review. Heavy reliance on state funding due to significant Medicaid exposure. Crossed into junk territory. Under review for further downgrade (potentially multi-notch).
Further decline in days cash on hand (~17 days as of Dec 31, 2025) despite several successful initiatives to supplement liquidity. Negative outlook at new rating.
